summary: DEFSEC Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the closing of a private placement, not a special situation. The company issued 1,951,219 common shares (or pre-funded warrants) at CAD$2.84 per share, with warrants exercisable at CAD$3.30 for 60 months, raising gross proceeds of approximately CAD$5.54 million (~US$4.0 million). H.C. Wainwright acted as exclusive placement agent, receiving a 7.5% cash fee and warrants. Net proceeds will fund business development, IP protection, and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction with no change of control, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review; thus it does not qualify as a special situation.
